summary: Push C day. Breakfast and pre-workout are grab-and-go (overnight oat protein smoothie, egg, turkey, bagel) since nothing needs prep. Lunch is a lean turkey-and-pasta plate with sweet potato and black beans for carbs/fiber. Dinner brings in Mary's Sticky Oyster Sauce Chicken for variety after yesterday's Korean Spicy Chicken, topped up with extra chicken breast and black beans for protein and fiber.
